title: Thai Chicken Wrap
description: A delicious and easy-to-make Thai-inspired chicken wrap recipe. Perfect for a quick and tasty meal.
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together curry paste and maple syrup.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the curry paste mixture.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned and cooked through.
Warm the tortilla by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the wrap by placing 2 slices of Canadian bacon on the tortilla, followed by the cooked chicken, and finally the remaining 2 slices of Canadian bacon.
Drizzle with any remaining curry paste mixture and serve immediately.
